recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, monochrome geometric composition featuring a series of nested, concentric white-outlined stadium shapes (capsules) on a solid black background. The shapes recede toward two focal points on either side of a central vertical void, creating a deep 3D tunnel effect through line weight and perspective.
coreVisualRelationships: Bilateral symmetry across a vertical axis
High contrast between thin white lines and solid black void
Convergence of lines toward internal vanishing points

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 60% of the canvas width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical black strip that divides the two sets of receding ellipses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the outer boundary and is drawn inward toward the two central vanishing points through the rhythmic repetition of lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space surrounding the central graphic and within the core of the tunnel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (#000000) as the primary background and negative space.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Absolute binary contrast with no mid-tones or gradients.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black square canvas. In the center, place a series of white-outlined stadium shapes (capsules) that are nested inside one another. The shapes should be split by a vertical black bar in the center. The outlines should get smaller and closer together as they move toward two central points on the left and right, creating a 3D tunnel effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is needed, use a ultra-lightweight sans-serif font placed at the bottom center, maintaining high tracking to match the minimalist geometric aesthetic.

verificationChecks: Check that all lines are pure white with no gray anti-aliasing artifacts
Verify the central vertical void is perfectly straight

adjustableVariables: Width of the central vertical void
Aspect ratio of the stadium shapes
postGenerationChecks: Are the lines perfectly smooth curves?
Does the image create a convincing 3D tunnel illusion?
Is the central vertical bar uniform in width?
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric repetition of [shape: stadium] + [effect: concentric recession] + [axis: vertical symmetry] + [palette: monochrome high contrast].
